saml-prerequisite.statement: SSO account authentication needs a SAML Entity ID and Reply URL generated in the platform (Generate SAML Details in the Authenticate section); the Authentication Type list stays disabled until the organization email domain is entered and saved.

quotes: Setting up single sign-on (SSO) account authentication requires generating a SAML Entity ID and Reply URL
Click Generate SAML Details to generate values for Entity ID and Reply URL.
If the Authentication Type drop-down menu is disabled, enter your organization's email domain name in the General Settings section and save your changes to enable it.
In the Authenticate section:

saml-options.statement: The SAML section also takes the identity provider name, the XML metadata from the provider, an option to disable the onboarding welcome emails for new SSO users, and a default idle period before SSO users are logged out (for example Never, 1 hour, 2 hours).

quotes: Identity Provider Name: Select the identity provider your organization uses (e.g., Okta).
SAML XML Metadata: Enter the configuration metadata generated by your SSO provider:
Disable welcome emails: Select the checkbox to disable the onboarding messages sent to new SSO users.
Idle Time For Logout: Select the default period of inactivity after which SSO users are logged out (e.g., Never, 1 hour, 2 hours).

domain-redirect-only-method.statement: For each of the five providers the page says SSO is configured per email domain, users with matching addresses are redirected to the provider, each user needs an account with the same email address in both the platform and the provider, and once SSO is enabled for a domain it becomes the only authentication method.

quotes: users with email addresses matching that domain are redirected to authenticate through Microsoft Entra ID
Each user must have an account with the same email address in both the Agentic SecOps Platform and Microsoft Entra ID.
After SSO is enabled for a domain, it becomes the only authentication method for the Agentic SecOps Platform.
users with email addresses matching that domain are redirected to authenticate through Okta
Each user must have an account with the same email address in both the Agentic SecOps Platform and in Okta.
After SSO is enabled for a domain, it becomes the only authentication method for the Agentic SecOps Platform.
users with email addresses matching that domain are redirected to authenticate through PingOne
Each user must have an account with the same email address in both the Agentic SecOps Platform and PingOne.
After SSO is enabled for a domain, it becomes the only authentication method for the Agentic SecOps Platform.
users with email addresses matching that domain are redirected to authenticate through PingFederate
Each user must have an account with the same email address in both the Agentic SecOps Platform and PingFederate.
After SSO is enabled for a domain, it becomes the only authentication method for the Agentic SecOps Platform.
users with email addresses matching that domain are redirected to authenticate through SecureAuth

no-idp-initiated-login.statement: The platform does not natively support IdP-initiated login; the PingOne page works around it with an Application Portal Link whose URL is https://app.avalor.io?domain=<Your Org Domain>, and the SecureAuth page uses the same host as the SP Login URL.

quotes: The Agentic SecOps Platform doesn't natively support identity provider (IdP)-initiated login.
URL: Enter https://app.avalor.io?domain=<Your Org Domain>, replacing <Your Org Domain> with your actual organization domain.
SP Login URL: Enter the URL https://app.avalor.io?domain=<your domain>.

pingone-app-settings.statement: In PingOne the SAML application is named "Agentic SecOps Platform- Authentication Only", gets the Reply URL as ACS URL and the Entity ID, maps the emailaddress claim to the Email Address attribute as Required, and is hidden from the Application Portal.

quotes: In the Application Name field, enter Agentic SecOps Platform- Authentication Only.
Under ACS URLs, enter the Reply URL you copied from the Agentic SecOps Platform.
Under Attributes, enter http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/emailaddress.
From the PingOne Mappings drop-down menu, select Email Address.
Select the Required checkbox.
deselect Display this application in the Application Portal.
For Entity ID, enter the Entity ID you copied from the Agentic SecOps Platform.

secureauth-app-settings.statement: In SecureAuth the SAML application uses an SP Initiated connection by redirect, the generated entity ID as IdP Issuer and the Reply URL as ACS, SAML assertion encryption disabled, and a SAML attribute carrying the user email under the emailaddress namespace.

quotes: you must generate a SAML Entity ID and Reply URL within the Agentic SecOps Platform.
Select SP Initiated from the Connection Type drop-down menu.
IdP Issuer: Enter the entity ID from Step 1.
Assertion Consumer Service (ACS): Enter the Reply URL from Step 1.
Encrypt SAML Assertion: Disable the toggle.
Data Store Property: Choose the value that represents the user's email (Email).
Namespace (1.1): Enter http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/ws/2005/05/identity/claims/emailaddress.
Select By Redirect.

metadata-sharing.statement: For PingOne and SecureAuth, the provider's XML metadata is pasted into the SAML XML MetaData field (a metadata URL is also supported but pasting is recommended), or shared with the Zscaler account team when the Authenticate section is not visible.

quotes: If the Authenticate section is not visible, share the XML metadata with your Zscaler Account team.
While a metadata URL is also supported, Zscaler recommends pasting the XML metadata directly.
In the Authenticate section, paste the XML metadata into the SAML XML MetaData field.
If the Authenticate section is not visible, share the XML metadata with your Zscaler Account team.
While a metadata URL is also supported, Zscaler recommends pasting the XML metadata directly.
In the Authenticate section, paste the XML metadata into the SAML XML MetaData field.

idp-setup-outlines.title: The Entra ID, Okta and PingFederate setup steps
idp-setup-outlines.detail: The captured Microsoft Entra ID, Okta and PingFederate pages hold only the introduction and step headings; the application registration, Okta bookmark app and app integration, and PingFederate registration steps are not in the capture. Only the PingOne and SecureAuth pages carry step content.

login-host-current.title: Whether app.avalor.io is the current login host for the Agentic SecOps Platform
login-host-current.detail: The PingOne and SecureAuth pages give app.avalor.io as the login host; no captured page states whether that host is current for the Agentic SecOps Platform.
